correctness.rationale: Herglotz positive-real derivative functions yield probability measures μ,ν and coefficient product λ=μ⋆ν. Thus the A_beta expression averages q_beta(ξz)=1+4∫_0^1(1-beta-beta log t) tξz/(1-tξz)dt. Its real angular kernel strictly increases in cos(theta) since derivative s(1-s²)/(1-2s cosθ+s²)²>0, giving sharp minimum at -r attained by both atomic extremizers f*=g*=-z-2log(1-z). Q_beta decreases with r and Q_beta(1)=4log2-3+beta(pi²/3-4log2); boundary gives beta*=(3/4-log2)/(pi²/12-log2), strict positivity on interior even at beta*. Anti-monotone covariance makes sharp radius increase in beta, R0 from log(1+R)=3R/4. Independently checked integral/series at multiple beta,r and exact extremal endpoint; not a finite proof.
